daily_credits_faq_a: With a verified email, you get 10 free credits the first time you open your account area each day (UTC), on up to 10 days a month. Daily credits are valid for 7 days and are used before your other credits. Accounts on {site} and {otherSite} that use the same email share one daily claim and one monthly limit, so claiming on one site counts for both.
